title: model
description: Cross-family type reference: named types, their descriptions, and occurrence paths across all schemas. Occurrence keys use the de-versioned family-dir grammar (model_join.csv's): '<pipeline>/<family>', resolved against the family's latest version; values are instance JSON Pointers into a datum of that family. Curated under the two-loop disposal discipline of issue #19: the name scan feeds model_join.csv at leisure; a model_join edge asserting one shared type obligates an entry here or a rejection in model_rejected.txt, gated by check_model_obligations; check_model_occurrences holds these pointers to the schemas; the table rsc/model/model.json validates against this schema (check_model_table).
